---
title: "Main table"
---

```{r}
#| label: main-table
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| 

library(dplyr)

source("helpers.R")

dat <- read.csv("intermediates/final_dat.csv") |> 
  mutate(Ticks = factor(Ticks))

fancy_dt(dat[c("ID", "Ticks", "year", "ArticleTitle", "city")], 
         options = list(pageLength = 50,
                        dom = "Bfrtip",
                        columnDefs = list(
                          list(targets = 0, render = render_publication),
                          list(targets = 4, render = render_city)),
                        buttons = c("copy", "csv")))

```
